column1: # Synthetic test set for the spike (text only; audio is generated locally with macOS `say`
# Consecutive rows with the same file_id are spoken in order into one file.
# The script maps lang to a voice per profile ("natural": Alice / Samantha / Daniel;
# "eloquence": the robotic Eddy/Flo voices). Mixed files either alternate languages
# between speakers (inter-sentence) or put English terms inside Italian sentences
# (intra-sentence code-switching, spoken by the Italian voice).
